updates.title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: FTP and SFTP Protection Now Available
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now supports monitoring and protecting sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols from managed endpoints, enabling admins to prevent unauthorized exfiltration via these file transfer methods. Organizations can configure FTP and SFTP activities directly in Endpoint DLP policies to enforce restrictive actions based on their security requirements.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Expands to Microsoft Cowork
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention capabilities now extend to Microsoft Cowork, allowing admins to enforce a single unified policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork environments. The integration prevents use of labeled knowledge sources, blocks prompts containing sensitive information types, and restricts sensitive data from being sent to Bing for web search.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Restrict External Email Processing in Microsoft 365 Copilot
updates.summary: Purview DLP is expanding to block Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing emails from external senders, reducing data exfiltration risks in AI-assisted workflows. This real-time control helps organizations maintain data boundaries when using Copilot features with potentially sensitive external communications.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Expanded Inline Protection for Unmanaged Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: DLP policies will support inline protection for a significantly broader set of unmanaged generative AI apps within Edge for Business, extending data security controls through the browser. Admins can leverage existing Purview policy interfaces to detect and protect sensitive data shared with more AI destinations without manual integration.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Version Trimming for Retention Policies
updates.summary: Compliance admins will be able to enable automatic version trimming on SharePoint and OneDrive files covered by retention policies, reducing storage bloat while preserving legal hold and records compliance obligations. This policy-scoped setting allows organizations to manage file-version proliferation without breaking retention promises.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Information Protection: Auto-labeling for Legacy Office Formats
updates.summary: Server-side auto-labeling will now support legacy Microsoft Office file formats (.doc, .xls, .ppt), allowing organizations to automatically evaluate and apply sensitivity labels to older file types in SharePoint and OneDrive. This extends label automation to legacy content that would otherwise require manual classification.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Archive mailbox access is now available through Microsoft Graph APIs, providing users and admins with seamless unified access to archive data regardless of whether it resides in main or auxiliary mailboxes. This change supports the October 2026 deprecation of EWS Graph APIs and simplifies archive management.
